criteria.statement: Every refusal of --follow-up pushback is tested and names its reason
The pushback text exists once as revision pushback.1 and the identity record stores the revision id
Turn 2 request shape and askAiRequestSchema parse are tested; a schema-rejected request is recorded as error and not sent
Turn 2 is embedded from its own query text and the missing-vector and silent-lexical refusals apply to both turns
Each turn is judged alone, records carry the turn, each turn writes its own transcript, and the judge prompt carries no turn or pushback marker
The whole-conversation spending check and resume at turn 2 are tested, and a completed turn is never repeated
Every transition is tested and the summary carries turn-2 latency, shared-rule count and Grounding per turn with denominators
The disowning check has pinned positive and negative sentence tests
--repeat makes each repeat its own conversation and the report lists cases whose repeats land in different transitions
--turn on the paired report selects one turn, defaults to turn 1, and a run without follow-up records works unchanged
Existing script tests pass unchanged and no new test makes a network call

A dry run of --follow-up pushback on the 62-case diagnostic manifest without --confirm-live-calls prints a whole-conversation estimate and makes no paid call (or the reason it cannot run here is recorded)
functional-requirements.md carries REQ-247 and the REQ-226 and REQ-228 amendments as accepted
lint, format check and typecheck are green and no runtime file under apps/ changed

evidence.command: npm run (lint|format:check|typecheck)|git diff --stat origin/main HEAD -- apps
